words.example: The storm began to abate before dawn.
The wording of the notice was ambiguous.
She gave a coherent account of the event.
Limited funding constrained the project.
The situation may deteriorate without action.
The survey is divided into three discrete sections.

words.meaning: 以经验为依据的；实证的
words.example: The claim needs empirical support.
We need a feasible plan before we start.
Every method has inherent limitations.
Trees can help mitigate urban heat.
Notwithstanding the cost, the upgrade was approved.
The old system is now obsolete.
The belief is still prevalent in some areas.
The study followed a rigorous method.
Safety must never be subordinate to speed.
The policy cannot sustain long-term growth alone.
Inconsistent rules undermine public trust.
The market remains volatile.
Allocate enough time for review.
Clear feedback provides an incentive to continue.
Readers may interpret the evidence differently.
The subsequent review found no major errors.
Some delay is inevitable during migration.
The team proposed a viable alternative.

practice.title: 主旨题：从材料结构判断中心
practice.prompt: A passage opens with a problem, compares two responses, and ends by recommending a cautious trial. What is the best way to identify its main idea?
options: 综合首尾与转折后的观点
practice.explanation: 主旨题要综合开头提出的问题、主体论证和结尾态度，尤其留意转折和建议句。

practice.title: 细节题：定位与同义替换
practice.prompt: When a question asks why a policy was revised, which step should come first?
options: 定位题干关键词并核对原因句
practice.explanation: 先用题干关键词定位，再确认原文中的因果关系，不能只依据选项熟悉度。

practice.title: 听力：先读选项再抓关系
practice.prompt: 本题为听力策略练习。播放原音后，优先关注选项中的人物、动作和因果关系。当前没有绑定音频文件。
options: 预测场景并抓转折、数字与态度
practice.explanation: 六级听力更适合先预测场景，再抓转折、态度和关键事实。当前条目标记为无音频样本。

practice.title: 词性判断：先看句法位置
practice.prompt: The committee adopted a more ______ approach after reviewing the evidence.
practice.explanation: 冠词 a 后、名词 approach 前需要形容词，因此选 rigorous。

practice.title: 开头段：明确现象与观点
practice.prompt: Write 80–120 words on how students can protect focused study time in a distracted environment.
practice.explanation: 自评时检查：是否明确回应主题、是否有清楚的论点、是否使用至少两种衔接方式。网站未配置在线 AI 评分，不会把规则检查冒充语义评分。

practice.title: 翻译：先拆分长句
practice.prompt: 请将下句译成英文：稳定的复习节奏比临近考试时突击更有利于长期记忆。
practice.explanation: 参考思路：先确定主干“稳定的复习节奏更有利于长期记忆”，再处理比较关系“比……更”。

grammarUnits.title: 非谓语动词
grammarUnits.summary: 用动作的逻辑主语和时间关系判断 to do、doing、done。
examples: Having finished the review, she checked the answers.
The evidence collected yesterday is still useful.
pitfalls: 先找句子谓语，再判断其余动词形式。
注意分词逻辑主语是否与主句主语一致。

grammarUnits.title: 从句与连接词
grammarUnits.summary: 先区分名词性、定语和状语从句，再依据句意选择连接方式。
examples: What matters is whether the plan is feasible.
The reason why the plan changed was clear.
pitfalls: 不要把 that、which、what 当作可互换。
先检查从句是否缺成分。

grammarUnits.title: 倒装与强调
grammarUnits.summary: 识别否定副词、only、so/such 等触发条件，先还原普通语序。
examples: Only after the review did the team revise the plan.
Rarely do we see such a coherent explanation.
pitfalls: 倒装只改变助动词与主语位置，实义动词不随意提前。

grammarUnits.title: 主谓一致
grammarUnits.summary: 确定真正主语，排除介词短语、插入语和定语从句的干扰。
examples: The list of tasks is on the desk.
What the data show is not the whole story.
pitfalls: of 短语后的名词通常不是真正主语。
what 从句作主语时按整体判断。
